notes: §1985:XVI.2.2.4 GR2: "General rules concerning computer-name, the MEMORY SIZE clause, and the PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE clause are presented in the Nucleus module", so in the Segmentation OBJECT-COMPUTER format those clauses keep §1985:VI.4.4.4 (GR5: "the program collating sequence is the collating sequence associated with alphabet-name-1"). The one objectComputerParagraph rule carries memorySizeClause, programCollatingSequenceClause and segmentLimitClause; SpecialNamesBinder.BindSpecialNames binds the PCS whatever clause follows it; the 85 gates (VisitMemorySizeClause, VisitProgramCollatingSequenceClause, VisitObjectComputerParagraph) admit the single-name form and the required computer-name. The witness pairs PCS with SEGMENT-LIMIT IS 49 and prints PROGRAM SEQUENCE. Probes: r2a (MEMORY SIZE 8 MODULES + PCS + SEGMENT-LIMIT 1, with a condition-name range and a contained program) PCS / CN-OUT / INNER PCS (VI.4.4.4 GR2 inheritance and GR7 b); r2n, r2o (PCS without IS, then SEGMENT-LIMIT IS) PCS; class b: r2c clause twice COBOL2423, r2b/r2h out of format order COBOL2987, r2e clause without computer-name COBOL0900; class c: r2d CHARACTER CLASSIFICATION and r2g PCS FOR ALPHANUMERIC refused COBOL0900. A PCS followed by an IS-less SEGMENT-LIMIT is refused (r2m); that is the SEGMENT-LIMIT clause's recognition and is recorded on 1985-GR-XVI.2.2.4-3.

next.reason: 1985: "General rules concerning computer-name, the MEMORY SIZE clause, and the PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE clause are presented in the Nucleus module"; 2023: "No Segmentation module, so no such pointer; the 12.3.6.4 rules cover computer-name and PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE but have no MEMORY SIZE rule". The rule only points from the Segmentation module to the Nucleus. 2023 has no Segmentation module, and its OBJECT-COMPUTER rules no longer have MEMORY SIZE.
